business_concept: One non-authoritative narrative realization for exactly one formal Planning event within one bounded segment packet.
minimum_input_authority: one exact formal-event contract and ordinal
bounded READY/StoryState/Canon projections required by that event
predecessor boundary projection or explicit first-event sentinel
source hashes and dependency artifact identifiers

relationships.beat: not created or owned; a future stage may decompose the realization
relationships.scene: not allocated; narrative only supplies realization content
relationships.causal_state: consumes bounded preconditions but does not author exit_state in Slice 1
relationships.draft: no direct consumer during shadow; comparison and replay evidence only
